mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last 3 months signals a tightening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the last 2 months signals increased demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the last month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% in the last month, it signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% in the last month, it signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals tightening monetary conditions with a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary conditions with strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.
